newsitem.title: USA: Donors meet to review Palestinian aid.
newsitem.headline: Donors meet to review Palestinian aid.

text.p: Senior officials from 15 nations met at the State Department on Thursday to review an international aid program for Palestinian self-rule areas in the West Bank and Gaza Strip.

State Department spokesman Glyn Davies said the meeting would look at implementation of projects in Palestinian areas, budgetary questions and donor coordination, and seek ways to address Palestinian economic problems.
Norway was chairing the meeting of the so-called ad hoc liaison committee of donor countries.
Donors promised $2.4 billion of aid over five years after Israel and the Palestinians signed their first peace agreement in 1993.

But the program has been plagued by complaints from the Palestinians that donors have been slow to deliver the aid, and objections from donors that the Palestinians have failed to account adequately for money spent.
Thursday's meeting, although long planned, came one day after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, elected in May, held his first meeting with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
